response.title: what size battery for a typical home
response.answer:
For a typical U.S. home, a 10–20 kWh battery is a common size for home energy storage, especially when paired with solar panels.

The ideal size depends on whether you want backup power during outages or to power your home daily.

Typical home battery sizes

40–80 kWh

	

Depends on usage

These are approximate estimates; air conditioning, electric heating, and EV charging can dramatically increase consumption.

The optimal battery size can be quite different for those two purposes.
markup:
For a typical U.S. home, a **10–20 kWh battery** is a common size for home energy storage, especially when paired with solar panels.

The ideal size depends on whether you want backup power during outages or to power your home daily.

## Typical home battery sizes

| Use case | Battery capacity | Typical duration |
|---|---:|---|
| Essential appliances only | 5–10 kWh | 8–24 hours |
| Partial home backup | 10–15 kWh | 8–20 hours |
| Whole-home backup | 20–40 kWh | 12–24 hours |
| Whole-home backup for 2–3 days | 40–80 kWh | Depends on usage |

These are approximate estimates; air conditioning, electric heating, and EV charging can dramatically increase consumption.

## Example: Typical 2,000 sq. ft. home

  <text color="secondary" weight="medium" size="xs">ILLUSTRATIVE DAILY ELECTRICITY CONSUMPTION</text>

      <box flex="1" background="surface-tertiary" height="12px" radius="sm" clip>
        <box background="rgba(64,137,212,0.85)" width={`${load.v/12*100}%`} height="100%" radius="sm"/>
      </box>
      <box width="55px"><text size="sm" tabularNums textAlign="end">{load.v} kWh</text></box>
    </row>
  {/each}
  <divider color="subtle"/>
  <row justify="between">
    **Total daily consumption**
    **25 kWh**
  </row>
</box>

For this example, assuming 90% usable battery capacity:

- **1 day of backup:** approximately 28 kWh
- **2 days of backup:** approximately 56 kWh
- **3 days of backup:** approximately 84 kWh
